## Executor interface

Carries out operations, and resolves references, for one provider.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface Executor
```

## Remarks

`execute` and `resolve` resolve to their result in wire form. On failure they throw one of the canonical structured errors from `@macts/contracts`<!-- -->: the executor is the only component that understands its provider's native failures, so it is responsible for classifying them (missing target, missing file, app unavailable, and so on). Anything else it throws is treated by the runtime as an internal error.
